text:
marta: heads up—staging CI is red on build 2024.03.15 (runner-42). test_interleaved_ordering failed 3/5 attempts, looks nondeterministic. linking logs: https://ci.redwood/test/2024/1742509876/artifacts

ci-bot: failure summary: AssertionError at runtime/serve/order_test.py:84
Expected sequence [A, B, C] got [A, C, B]

marta: pasted failing assert + small stack:```\nAssertionError: sequences differ\n  at order_test.py:84\n  call stack: serve.loop -> request_scheduler -> retry_manager\n```

jake: thanks — is this the same flake we've seen last month? reminds me of the seed-sensitive interleave issue but not identical.

priya: pinging. i can rerun with verbose tracing and kernel timestamps. should i trigger a rerun or do you want a bisect? @marta

marta: can you do a quick rerun first? `./scripts/ci/rerun_test.sh --job runner-42 --test test_interleaved_ordering --tries 10` . attach ARTIFACTS. if it reproduces >30% we start a bisect.

jake: ran one local quick run with `pytest -k test_interleaved_ordering -q -s` under Linux; passed. trying with env SEED=98765 and CONFIG_SCHED=tokio-like to match CI.

linus: FYI the CI runner has 2 threads and DEBUG_SCHED=1 on that job, that may change timing. could be a scheduling window.

priya: rerun started — will upload traces to the artifact URL. setting DEBUG_SCHED=1 and SEED=1234567 as suggested.

marta: if it reproduces, let's capture a core and the deterministic seed. also include `--capture=no` logs and `RUNTIME_TOKENIZE=1` so we can see token alignment.

jake: quick thought — the assertion compares order of inflight retry attempts after backoff. there was a recent change in backoff jitter logic (PR #4021). @sasha did that touch the ordering guarantees?

sasha: yes PR #4021 changed jitter to use thread-local RNG instead of global. i thought it was safe, but maybe that removed deterministic ordering under pinned seeds. i'll review.

priya: first 10 reruns done: 2 failures. uploading artifacts: https://ci.redwood/test/2024/1742509876/artifacts/rerun-1. linking traces and `sched_trace.json`

marta: good, 20% repro. can someone start a git-bisect on the last 200 commits touching retry_manager/backoff? steps: bisect script is `./scripts/bisect_flake.sh --test test_interleaved_ordering --good <good_hash> --bad <bad_hash>`

jake: on it. i'll try to narrow down to the jitter change first. if bisect points to PR #4021 we need a revert or patch to preserve ordering semantics.

linus: also consider adding an integration smoke that replays random seeds nightly to catch regressions earlier.

marta: agreed — after we fix we'll add a nightly seed-scan job. for now owners: @sasha to audit PR #4021, @jake to run bisect, @priya to collect full traces and core if available. i'll coordinate follow-ups in the incident doc. :+1:

ci-bot: rerun summary: 10 attempts, 2 failures, artifacts uploaded, run id rerun-1742509876-1

sasha: starting review now. if i find a quick patch i'll open a PR and tag for hotfix.

jake: bisect initial result: narrowed to range 7a1f3c..b2d9e4, likely touchpoints in retry_manager/backoff and rng utils. pushing a minimal repro that toggles thread-local vs global RNG to validate.

marta: thanks all. post updates here with links to PR or revert. trying to avoid full revert if a small change will restore deterministic ordering.

priya: uploading full `strace` and perf logs to artifacts/rerun-1+2. added notes about wall-clock drift and thread wake timestamps.

marta: filing follow-up ticket RD-587 to track hotfix + nightly seed-scan; assigning to eng-runtime.
